sources.title: Most Common Last Names In Portugal
sources.territory: Portugal (POR), national territorial page, not Brazil
sources.period: 2014 distribution snapshot
sources.scope: Initial 355 distinct surname values from 362 visible rows on the Portugal-only 2014 Forebears ranking. The 145 further values are documented by six additional Portugal-indexed alphabetic surname lists.
sources.limitations: Forebears source provides modelled surname incidence, not Portugal administrative records; its published display covers only ranks 1–362, with spelling variants/duplicates removed. Supplementary lists are secondary estimates and may derive from Forebears. No numeric estimates are used as weights; licensing and item-level corroboration are pending.
